summary: The standalone Lemma 3.1 in the r15 report omitted a factor 2^(1/4): the correct bound is 16*2^(1/4)|d|^(-1/4)|Delta|^(-1/8). In the actual scalar-pivot application Delta=-4d(G-t), this factor cancels 4^(-1/8), so equation (4.6), Theorem 4.1 with constant 96, the physical-pair consequence, and full-target status are unchanged.
